artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_m=\sum_{j=1}^m 1/j$ denote harmonic numbers, $E_n$ the Euler numbers (defined by $\operatorname{sech} t=\sum_{n\ge 0}E_n t^n/n!$), and $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ the Legendre symbol. For positive integers $a,b,c,d$, write the multinomial coefficient $\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}=(4k)!/(k!)^4$.

Establish (or refute) the following three groups of statements.

(i) For every integer $n\ge 2$,
$$\frac{2n}{\binom{2n}{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(6k+1)\binom{2k}{k}^3 256^{\,n-1-k}\in\mathbb Z,\qquad \frac{2n}{\binom{2n}{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(6k+1)\binom{2k}{k}^3(-512)^{\,n-1-k}\in\mathbb Z,$$
$$\frac{2n}{\binom{2n}{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(42k+5)\binom{2k}{k}^3 4096^{\,n-1-k}\in\mathbb Z.$$

(ii) For every prime $p>3$ and every positive integer $a$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p^a-1)/2}\frac{42k+5}{4096^k}\binom{2k}{k}^3\equiv \left(\frac{-1}{p^a}\right)\!\Big(5-\tfrac{3}{4}p\,H_{p-1}\Big)\pmod{p^4},$$
and
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{6k+1}{256^k}\binom{2k}{k}^3\equiv p\!\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)-p^3 E_{p-3}\pmod{p^4},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{6k+1}{(-512)^k}\binom{2k}{k}^3\equiv p\!\left(\frac{-2}{p}\right)+p^3\!\left(\frac{2}{p}\right)\!E_{p-3}\pmod{p^4},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{42k+5}{4096^k}\binom{2k}{k}^3\equiv 5p\!\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)-p^3 E_{p-3}\pmod{p^4}.$$

(iii) For every prime $p>3$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{7k+1}{648^k}\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}\equiv p\!\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)-\tfrac{5}{3}p^3 E_{p-3}\pmod{p^4}.$$
Moreover, for each integer $n\ge 2$,
$$\frac{2n(2n+1)}{\binom{2n}{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(7k+1)\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}648^{\,n-1-k}\in\mathbb Z,$$
unless $2n+1$ is a power of $3$, in which case the rational number above has denominator equal to $3$.
artifact.status_search_result: The integer-valuedness statements in part (i) (and the analogous integer-valuedness in part (iii)) belong to a family of Sun's conjectures on integer-valued polynomials whose divisibility/integrality has been addressed by V. J. W. Guo (e.g., "Proof of Sun's conjectures on integer-valued polynomials", arXiv:1601.04250). The mod $p^4$ supercongruences in (ii) and (iii) involving the Euler number $E_{p-3}$ are deeper supercongruences in Z.-W. Sun's conjecture lists; while several closely related supercongruences of this type have been proved in subsequent literature, no single source confirming all four mod-$p^4$ congruences in (ii) and the mod-$p^4$ congruence in (iii) was located. Overall the conjecture appears partially solved with some pieces still open.

status_evidence.title: Proof of Sun's conjectures on integer-valued polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Proves two conjectures of Z.-W. Sun asserting that certain rational sums involving even powers of polynomials are integers when evaluated at integers.
status_evidence.claim: Integer-valuedness conjectures of Sun in this family have been (at least partially) proved by V. J. W. Guo.

status_evidence.title: Proof of Sun's conjecture on the divisibility of certain binomial sums
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes divisibility/integrality results for binomial sums conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Several integer-valuedness conjectures of Sun on binomial sums have been verified.

status_evidence.title: On a Supercongruence Conjecture of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a mod p^4 supercongruence conjectured by Z.-W. Sun involving Euler numbers.
status_evidence.claim: Some, but not all, of Sun's mod p^4 supercongruences of this shape have been proved.
